hero.headline: Wall Street posts its best week since April 2025 as a December Fed rate hike looks near certain.
hero.dek: Every story on FIOPO is traced to where it lands: your fuel, your rent, your savings, your job. Here is how today's biggest story travels.

chain.label: The event
chain.text: The S&P 500 rose 1.60% to 7,297.49 in Friday's half day session, capping a 5.6% weekly gain, its best week since April 2025, N Globe reports. The Nasdaq rose 6.7% on the week and the Dow 5.5%, its biggest weekly gain since October 2022.

chain.label: The driver
chain.text: All 11 S&P sectors rose on Friday, led by technology at 2.80%, CappNotes reports. SanDisk jumped 15.96% and Micron 7.60%. Anthropic closed at $91.88, above its $83.00 IPO price, StockTitan says.

chain.label: The catch
chain.text: Bond yields rose with stocks. The 10 year Treasury yield climbed 9 basis points to 4.94% and the 2 year to 4.69%, after core PCE inflation came in hotter than expected this week, CappNotes reports.

chain.label: The Fed
chain.text: CME FedWatch showed market odds of 97.4% for a quarter point Fed rate hike at the December 8 to 9 meeting, CappNotes reports. Polymarket put a December quarter point hike at 94.5%.

chain.label: You
chain.text: Higher yields feed through to mortgage, car and card rates, while savings rates tend to rise after hikes. One relief: AAA's US gas average was $3.53 on November 28, down from $3.72 on November 19.

hero.caption: Sources: N Globe, CappNotes, StockTitan and AAA, November 19 to 28, 2026. Fed odds are market odds. The chain itself is FIOPO analysis.

stories.headline: US stocks post their best week since April 2025 while bond yields climb.
stories.happened: In Friday's shortened session the S&P 500 rose 1.60% to 7,297.49, the Dow 591.99 points, or 1.18%, to 50,774.94 and the Nasdaq 2.31% to 24,129.50, N Globe reports. For the week the S&P gained 5.6%, the Nasdaq 6.7% and the Dow 5.5%. All 11 sectors rose, technology led at 2.80%, and the VIX fear gauge fell 15.84% to 23.81, CappNotes reports.
stories.happening: The 10 year Treasury yield rose 9 basis points to 4.94%, the 2 year to 4.69% and the 30 year to 5.33%. The dollar index rose 0.36% to 104.04. CME FedWatch showed market odds of 97.4% for a quarter point hike at the Fed's December 8 to 9 meeting, CappNotes says. Next week brings ISM manufacturing and JOLTS job openings on Tuesday, December 1.

could.text: A strong rebound week is meeting rising yields and a likely Fed hike, a mix that can limit further stock gains into December.

you: After a 5.6% week, check whether stocks now make up more of your savings than you planned, and rebalance if so.
Shopping for a mortgage or car loan? Ask for a rate lock; the 10 year yield, which steers mortgage rates, rose to 4.94%.
Holding cash? Compare high yield savings and certificate rates, which tend to rise after Fed hikes.
stories.watch: ISM and JOLTS on Tuesday, December 1, and the Fed on December 9.

stories.headline: Iran says it is negotiating with the US through Qatar and Pakistan as OPEC+ meets Sunday.
stories.happened: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on November 26 that Tehran is negotiating with the US through Qatari and Pakistani mediators and that Iran has demands that "must be met, so the Strait of Hormuz can be opened," Political.org reports. Qatar's Foreign Ministry spokesman Majed al-Ansari said both sides are engaging in the mediation. The US naval blockade of Iranian ports has been in place since July 14.
stories.happening: Brent settled at $95.44 a barrel on Friday and US crude at $83.08, CappNotes reports, and Brent posted its first weekly gain in five weeks, Rigzone says. Kpler data put Strait of Hormuz flows at 31% of prewar levels. OPEC+ meets Sunday, November 29, to set 2027 baselines; Saxo Bank says targets are widely expected to stay unchanged. Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador on Friday, Khaleej Times reports.

odds.label: Brent at or above $100 on Dec 27

could.note: FIOPO read for the next 30 days, given repeated attacks on Gulf energy sites and the OPEC+ decision. Judgment, not fact.

you: Driving this weekend? AAA's US average was $3.53 on November 28; fill up where posted prices are lowest.
Heat with heating oil or propane? Compare suppliers now, since oil price moves reach heating fuel quickly.
Flying through the Gulf? Check your airline's updates before you leave for the airport.
stories.watch: The OPEC+ meeting on Sunday, November 29.

stories.headline: Dangote's refinery is set to start trading in Lagos on Tuesday after a $2.08 billion share sale.
stories.happened: Dangote Petroleum Refinery will begin trading on the Nigerian Exchange on Tuesday, December 1, a week earlier than planned, Billionaires.Africa reported on November 27, citing Bloomberg. The offer raised $2.08 billion at ₦525 a share, 30% above its base target, with bids of about ₦5.85 trillion ($4.3 billion). The listing values the refinery at about ₦65.2 trillion ($47.8 billion).
stories.happening: Aliko Dangote's stake falls from about 87.3% to roughly 84%. Intellinews said in September the sale was expected to be Africa's biggest ever. In the US, CrowdStrike agreed on November 23 to buy Zscaler in an all stock deal worth about $43.9 billion, a premium of roughly 34%, SecurityWeek reports; Infosecurity Magazine calls it the largest cybersecurity acquisition ever.

could.text: The first days of trading will test how much demand there is for a large Nigerian listing; new listings often swing sharply at first.

you: Bought shares in the offer? Check your allotment with your broker before you trade on Tuesday.
New listings can move sharply in the first days; set a price limit rather than placing a market order.
Hold an emerging markets or Africa fund? Check whether it plans to add the new listing.
stories.watch: The first trade on the Nigerian Exchange on Tuesday, December 1.

stories.headline: Adobe expects $12.9 billion in US online Black Friday spending, up 9.2% from last year.
stories.happened: Adobe forecast that US shoppers would spend $12.9 billion online on Black Friday, up 9.2% from a year earlier, N Globe reports. Thanksgiving Day online spending reached a record $7.1 billion, up 10.4%, according to Adobe data cited by CappNotes. "Black Friday" was the top trending topic on X in the US on Friday, HomeWord reports.
stories.happening: Adobe expects $15.1 billion in online spending on Cyber Monday, November 30, CappNotes says. Investors bet on the season: the S&P 500's consumer discretionary sector rose 2.11% on Friday. Hotel chains are also running sales; Marriott Bonvoy's runs through December 1 and IHG's through December 3, Packzup reports.

could.text: Spending is rising in dollars, but part of that reflects higher prices; Cyber Monday will show whether shoppers keep the pace.

you: Before you buy, check the item's price history over the past month to confirm the discount is real.
Using buy now, pay later? Add every installment to your budget so several small plans do not stack up.
Read the return window before you check out; holiday return rules vary by store.
stories.watch: Adobe's Cyber Monday tally on Monday, November 30.

calc.gas_note: US average $3.53 on November 28, 2026 vs about $3.04 a year earlier (AAA).

evening.kicker: Evening: the world and the economy
evening.headline: Spain votes Sunday in a general election
evening.watch: OPEC+ meets Sunday. China's factory data Monday, India's GDP Nov 30, US ISM Tuesday.

evening.caption:
Spain holds a general election on Sunday, November 29, with 176 of 350 seats needed for a majority. A GAD3 poll for ABC projects 131 seats for the PP, 110 for the PSOE and 63 for Vox. The official count is due December 4.

Also watch OPEC+ on Sunday and Asia and Europe opens Monday. General information. More at fiopoin.com

regions.covers: China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Southeast Asia
regions.headline: Shanghai stocks jump 3.73% ahead of Monday's factory data.
regions.text: The Shanghai Composite rose 3.73% to 3,606.49 on Friday and the Shenzhen Component 7.24% to 10,814.02 after a State Council meeting pledged stronger capital market support, CrossPacificWatchers reports. A Reuters poll expects China's official November manufacturing PMI, due Monday, at 49.4, a second month below the 50 line that separates growth from contraction. The private RatingDog PMI is due Tuesday.
regions.you: Hold a China fund? Monday's factory data can move markets; rebalance rather than chase a one day jump.

regions.covers: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka
regions.headline: India reports July to September growth on November 30; Ind-Ra expects 7.6%.
regions.text: India Ratings and Research expects growth of 7.6% for July to September, led by investment, after 7.8% in April to June, PTI reports. The government is slated to release the data on November 30. Chief economist Devendra Kumar Pant said consumption is "likely to come under some pressure" from higher interest rates and fading tax cut effects. The RBI forecasts 7.2% for the quarter.
regions.you: Investing in India funds? Compare Monday's figure with the 7.2% RBI forecast; a gap either way can move the rupee and stocks.

regions.headline: Spain holds a general election on Sunday, with 176 seats needed for a majority.
regions.text: Polls are open from 9:00 to 20:00 Spain time on November 29, and the official count is due December 4, The Rio Times reports. In a GAD3 poll for ABC the PP leads with 131 projected seats, ahead of the PSOE on 110 and Vox on 63, Euronews reports; the state pollster CIS puts the PSOE first. Spain's flash inflation estimate eased to 4.1% in November from 4.9%.
regions.you: Hold Spanish stocks or bonds? Expect moves on Monday as results come in; avoid trading on early counts.

sources.name: The Rio Times, Spain election, Nov 27

regions.headline: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey meet in Islamabad as Kuwait summons Iran's ambassador.
regions.text: The foreign ministers of Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey were scheduled to meet in Islamabad on November 27 and 28, Political.org reports, and Khaleej Times reports they agreed principles for new members of their Makkah alliance. Kuwait summoned Iran's ambassador and handed over a protest note on Friday. Iran said it fired warning shots to drive a US F-16 from its airspace near Hormuz, an Iranian account.
regions.you: Traveling to the Gulf? Check your government's travel advice and your airline before you go.

regions.covers: Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Egypt, Zambia
regions.headline: Naspers revenue rises 55% in six months, but its shares fall 4.35%.
regions.text: South Africa's Naspers said half year revenue to September rose 55% to $6.37 billion, while profit from continuing operations fell 27% to $4.1 billion and adjusted earnings per share rose 12%, Billionaires.Africa reports. Its N shares fell 4.35% to R611.16 on results day. In Nigeria, Dangote's refinery is due to start trading on Tuesday.
regions.you: Own Naspers through a South African fund? Look past the headline revenue to profit, which fell.

regions.headline: Argentina's Congress bars the central bank from printing money to fund the government.
regions.text: Argentina's Chamber of Deputies gave final approval on November 26 to a law that limits central bank financing of the government and makes protecting the currency's value its main mission, by 141 to zero with 99 abstentions, Al Jazeera reports. President Javier Milei said it ends "nearly two decades of political manipulation." Governor Axel Kicillof criticized a separate election bill that would suspend primaries.
regions.you: Planning a trip to Argentina? Check the peso rate and card fees before you go; policy changes can move the currency.

sports.headline: Palmeiras and Estudiantes play for a $25 million Copa Libertadores prize tonight.
sports.text: Brazil's Palmeiras face Argentina's Estudiantes in the single match final on November 28 at Estadio Centenario in Montevideo, Uruguay. The champion earns $25 million, $1 million more than last year, and up to $40 million across all stages, plus places in the 2029 FIFA Club World Cup and the Intercontinental Cup. The clubs last met in the 1968 final, which Estudiantes won.
sports.you: Watching abroad? Check which streaming service holds the rights where you live before kickoff.

sports.headline: UEFA's agency names DAZN, Kayo and Foxtel for Champions League rights in Australia.
sports.text: UC3 named preferred bidders for UEFA club competition rights in 10 more markets, including DAZN with Kayo and Foxtel for the Champions League in Australia, with new deals starting July 2027, Sports Broadcasting News reports. Nine, owner of Stan, said carrying both the Premier League and UEFA rights "no longer aligned with our investment strategy."
sports.you: Follow European football in Australia? Stan keeps UEFA games through 2026/27; plan for a new subscription from July 2027.

sports.headline: MLB's labor deal expires Tuesday night after the league sued the players' union.
sports.text: MLB filed a federal complaint in New York on November 25 asking the court to declare a lockout lawful under antitrust law, MLB.com reports. The league seeks no damages and called the suit defensive; the players' union called it "completely frivolous." The labor deal expires at 11:59 p.m. ET on Tuesday, December 1.
sports.you: Buying 2027 tickets or season plans? Check the refund policy in case games are affected.

entertainment.headline: Sunrise on the Reaping takes $11.6 million on Thanksgiving Day.
entertainment.text: Lionsgate's The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping made $11.6 million on Thursday and is on track for $85 million over the five day break, which would lift its domestic total to $233 million, Variety reports. Universal's Focker-in-Law made $7.7 million and Disney's Hexed $4.5 million, with Hexed projected at $34.4 million for five days.
entertainment.you: Going this weekend? Matinee and weekday tickets are usually cheaper than evening shows.

entertainment.headline: K-pop closes a 247 release November with a new TAEYEON album on Monday.
entertainment.text: KpopComebacks counts 247 confirmed K-pop releases in November 2026: 15 full albums, 36 mini albums or EPs and 180 singles, plus 15 Japanese releases and one US release. TAEYEON of Girls' Generation releases the full album Unspecial at 6 p.m. Korea time on November 30, after releases this month from ATEEZ, NCT DREAM, ENHYPEN, NAYEON and BIGBANG.
entertainment.you: Buying albums or concert tickets? Use official stores and ticket sites to avoid resale markups and fakes.

items.text: "Black Friday" was the top US trending topic on X on November 27, HomeWord reports.
A TV spot and a teaser for Avengers: Doomsday, opening December 18, were among YouTube's top trending videos.
#HappyThanksgiving was among the fastest growing hashtags worldwide, up 598%, Tokchart shows.

innovation.headline: Chemists turn hard to recycle PVC plastic into high performance lubricating oil.
innovation.text: A Virginia Tech team led by Guoliang Liu converted PVC into polyalphaolefin, a synthetic lubricant base, by heating it with aluminum trichloride and alpha olefins to 158°F for three hours, ScienceDaily reported on November 27. The work, with Texas A&M and Caltech, is published in Nature. Scaling beyond the lab remains the next step.
innovation.you: Not yet a product; for now, check local rules, since PVC is rarely accepted in curbside recycling.

innovation.headline: A Falcon 9 is set to launch 11,000 pounds of cargo to the space station on Sunday.
innovation.text: NASA's Northrop Grumman CRS-25 mission is scheduled to launch a Cygnus XL cargo craft on a SpaceX Falcon 9 at 10:47 a.m. EST on November 29 from Cape Canaveral, Florida, NASA says, with a 60% chance of favorable weather. Separately, NASA shared a photo of the four Artemis III astronauts with their Orion spacecraft at Kennedy Space Center.
innovation.you: Near Florida's Space Coast? Launches are free to watch from public beaches; check the time on the morning of launch.

innovation.headline: AI startups took 47% of November's venture rounds as funding hit $49.9 billion.
innovation.text: 513 startups announced rounds totaling $49.9 billion in November through the 22nd, and AI and machine learning companies made up 241 of them, MyDigiFolio reports, citing tracker data. The largest included OpenAI's $11 billion and Isomorphic Labs' $5 billion Series C. 81 rounds were $100 million or more.
innovation.you: Job hunting in tech? Newly funded companies tend to hire; 82 of them have posted 1,610 open roles.

travel.headline: Curaçao: Caribbean winter sun that more travelers are searching for.
travel.text: Expedia's winter outlook, based on Canadian searches for December to February stays, shows Curaçao up 45%, Turks and Caicos up 30% and Aruba up 20%. Curaçao's all inclusive average daily rate is $337.
travel.you: Expedia's data says international hotels are cheapest around January 7 and February 1, 2027; build your dates around those.

travel.headline: Cancun tops winter searches; the trick is when you fly.
travel.text: Cancun is the most searched international winter destination in Expedia's outlook. Expedia says international flights are cheapest around February 22 and 23, 2027 and costliest around December 19 and 26.
travel.you: Can travel in late February? Set fare alerts now and compare all inclusive rates; Puerto Vallarta averages $235 a day.

travel.headline: Hotel chains' Black Friday sales end in the next few weeks.
travel.text: Marriott Bonvoy offers members 25% off in its app through December 1, IHG up to 30% through December 3, Wyndham up to 30% for four or more nights through December 4 and Hilton 20% for members through December 22, Packzup reports.
travel.you: Book only refundable rates unless your dates are fixed, and compare with the hotel's normal price before you pay.

picks.title: The Invisible Hand of Maria Edgeworth
picks.text: The New York Times journalist and author of Limitless profiles Maria Edgeworth, a Regency era novelist who corresponded with Thomas Malthus and David Ricardo and wove lessons on money and trade into her fiction. Named one of the New York Times Book Review's 100 Notable Books of 2026.

sources.name: Penguin Random House, NYT notable list

picks.title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
picks.by: Oobah Butler, directed by Daniel Lucchesi
picks.where: HBO and HBO Max, weekly from November 22
picks.text: A five episode documentary comedy in which journalist Oobah Butler tests industries from wine and wellness to dating apps by gaming online reviews and building invented brands. A practical look at how fake reviews and made up businesses can move real money.

items.text: NASA ran a developmental RS-25 Moon rocket engine for its full 200 seconds at Stennis Space Center.
Scientists found bacteria that removed about 98% of radioactive promethium-147 in 60 hours.
India declared at 720 for 9 in Wellington, the highest Test innings ever made in New Zealand.
NASA's Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth.
ESA and JAXA's BepiColombo entered orbit around Mercury after nearly eight years in space.
ESA's Hera is arriving at the asteroid Didymos to study the crater from NASA's DART impact.
Artemis II splashed down off San Diego after a 10 day trip around the Moon, the first crewed lunar voyage in more than 50 years.
NASA's Perseverance set the record for distance driven on another world, more than 45 km on Mars.
The Hubble Space Telescope completed its 200,000th orbit of Earth.
